annotations.title: Fill or fix the texting registration

description: Saves fields of the toll-free texting registration as a draft (only while it is a draft or was rejected; never while the carriers review it). Send only the fields you are changing. Every fact must come from the person: ask for the legal name, entity type, address, contact and how people opt in; never guess or invent them, because carriers reject registrations that don't match official records. You may draft the use case summary, opt-in description and sample messages for the person to approve: each sample starts with the business name and ends "Reply STOP to opt out". The registration number (EIN, or SSN for a sole proprietor) cannot be set here: the person enters it in the dashboard. Returns the saved form (number masked) and the checklist. Nothing is sent to the carriers. Requires API key scope: account.

confirm_opt_in.description: The person confirmed everyone they text agreed to it.

confirm_website.description: The person confirmed the website is theirs and public.

dba.description: Brand name customers see, if different.

legal_name.description: Exactly as on the official registration.

opt_in_description.description: How people agree to get texts, in plain words.

opt_in_url.description: Page where people sign up for texts.

vertical.description: Kind of business. Most are general; some kinds cannot be registered at all.
